title: The Lullaby Shift
summary: A night nurse hums one lullaby to keep a sleeping ward quiet until sunrise, and tonight someone is humming it back.

beats.text: I hum one lullaby every night to keep the ward asleep. Tonight, someone hummed it back.
The rule is simple. Noise wakes them. A lullaby keeps them still.
So every night I hummed, slow and soft, hallway to hallway, until sunrise.
At two, a second voice joined me from the far end. Same tune, a half-note flat.
I stopped. It stopped. Down the corridor, the swing doors began to sway.
If I stayed silent, the ward would wake. If I hummed, it would find me.
A small girl stood by a gurney, humming through tears.
A small girl stood by a gurney, humming through tears. She had been lost for days.
I took her hand. We hummed together until sunrise, flat note and all.
